Duniyadari | Ep. 1769 | 26th November, 2026
In today's show, Nikita Agarwal talks about three Chinese surveillance satellites equipped with radiofrequency tracking and electronic intelligence (ELINT) which stayed focused on the Gujarat coast during the entire duration of Operation Sindoor last year, a report by Bengaluru-based space surveillance company Digantara has found. The analysis shows that three Chinese satellites, Ningxia-14, Gaofen-11 and Yaogan 30 were laser focused on the Gujarat coast on 10 and 11 May, particularly the areas around Bhuj, Naliya and Jamnagar.
